Name: MENU_FILTER_ST
Description: Screen filter settings for menus: chromatic aberration, noise and contrast.

Fields.Name: Chromatic Aberration Deviation: 0
Fields.Description: Amount of chromatic aberration offset for this filter.

Fields.Name: Chromatic Aberration Deviation: 1
Fields.Description: Amount of chromatic aberration offset for this filter.

Fields.Name: Noise Texture: Index
Fields.Description: The index of the noise texture to use.

Fields.Name: Noise Texture: Mask Index
Fields.Description: The index of the noise texture mask to use.

Fields.Name: Noise Texture: Horizontal Scale
Fields.Description: Horizontal scale of the noise texture. Higher values show it larger.

Fields.Name: Noise Texture: Vertical Scale
Fields.Description: Vertical scale of the noise texture. Higher values show it larger.

Fields.Name: Noise Texture: Blend Rate
Fields.Description: The blending rate for the noise texture.

Fields.Name: Noise Texture: External Blend Rate
Fields.Description: How strongly the noise applies outside the menu's drawing area. 0: menu drawing area only; 1: the whole screen.

Fields.Name: Noise Texture: Update Interval
Fields.Description: Interval at which the noise texture's UVs are randomly updated. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Contrast
Fields.Description: The contrast value for this filter.

Fields.Name: Noise Centre Dilution
Fields.Description: Thins the noise at the centre of the screen. -1: no noise near the centre; 1: noise shows in the centre too.
